project.name: Inspecto — Case Management (optional)
project.description:
OPTIONAL add-on module (MODULE-REORG-P7, 2026-10-08): the Case Management add-on of plan section 8a. Case Rules (the registry, evaluation and the *_caserule.toon loader), Merge and Split of Cases, opening a Case from Link Analysis Entities with its compensation, the caserule.evaluate Job Type, and the routes that expose them (/cases/rules x4, POST /cases/from-entities, POST /objects/{id}/merge and /split). Package com.gamma.ops.cases.
Contributed through seams only: com.gamma.spi.http.RouteModule (feature id "cases"), com.gamma.job.JobTypeProvider (caserule.evaluate) and com.gamma.ops.ObjectEngineExtension (the config loader). It REQUIRES inspecto-ops and reaches the Object Engine through ObjectService.extension(...) / substrate(); the dependency direction is case-management to ops, never the reverse (ObjectService does not name any Case class).
What stays in inspecto-ops (substrate): the Case lifecycle (Workflow.defaultFor(CASE)), the generic SLA sweep of existing Case rows, Findings / Impact / Disposition handling, RCA seeding, /objects* CRUD, notes, links and tags. With this module absent, Case objects load and list inertly, an install without it still raises and works Incidents, and the Case routes answer 503 (stubs synthesised from this module's manifest).
Bundled from the Professional edition up (the Standard, Professional, Enterprise and Preview profiles). THIN: no shade, no sidecar classifier. Built only under the edition profiles, so a routine "mvn -o clean test" (= Personal) never compiles it.
